prompt.project_info: Create a vertical three-panel UGC close-up selfie collage of the same approved adult woman in a dim bedroom or hotel room.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy brunette hair, natural skin texture, minimal makeup, nude or pale-pink manicure, and an opaque pink camisole with modest coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Three stacked close-up panels: puzzled pout with finger near chin; soft smile with a pink heart crown filter; relaxed head tilt with hand near chin. Include beige walls, heavy brown curtain, partial bed headboard, and subtle early-2010s phone-camera grain.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm low-light indoor illumination with a restrained flash-photography look, casual playful mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic phone photography, tall vertical strip, 4:5 overall ratio, natural facial consistency across panels, mild grain, no invented text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical three-panel selfie collage featuring the same approved adult woman with long wavy brunette hair, wearing an opaque pink camisole with modest coverage in a warm dim bedroom. Show a puzzled pout, a soft smile with a pink heart crown filter, and a relaxed head tilt. Preserve identity, room, curtain, bed, manicure, and warm phone-camera grain across all panels. No lingerie styling, no sexualized gestures, no watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, bralette, transparent clothing, finger in mouth, exaggerated pout, inconsistent face, distorted hands, duplicate limbs, unreadable text, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
